app.title: Personality Test Center

mbti.title: MBTI Personality Test
mbti.description: Identify which of the 16 MBTI personality types fits you best. Explore how you process information, make decisions, and interact with others across four core dimensions.

eq.title: EQ Assessment
eq.description: Evaluate your emotional intelligence—how well you recognize, understand, and manage emotions. Includes 40 real-life scenarios across self-awareness, self-management, social awareness, and relationship management.

learningStyle.title: Learning Style Profiler
learningStyle.description: Discover the study methods that fit you best. Assess your visual, auditory, reading/writing, and kinesthetic preferences across 40 diverse learning scenarios.

bigFive.title: Big Five Personality Test
bigFive.description: Measure openness, conscientiousness, extraversion, agreeableness, and emotional stability with the well-established OCEAN framework.

holland.title: Holland RIASEC Career Test
holland.description: Discover your core career interests based on the RIASEC model. Assess across 6 dimensions to match your ideal work environment and long-term career path.

enneagramQuestions.title: Enneagram Deep Test
enneagramQuestions.description: Reveal your inner core motivations, fears, and desires. Identify your dominant type among 9 personality types and explore growth and stress patterns.

disc.title: DISC Behavioral Style
disc.description: Based on Marston's behavioral model, map your workplace communication style, decision-making preferences, and team role across dominance, influence, steadiness, and conscientiousness. Includes 30 scenario-based items.

resilience.title: Resilience Assessment
resilience.description: Measure your ability to bounce back from adversity. Assess emotional regulation, optimism, self-efficacy, and social support to build a complete picture of your psychological capital across 25 items.

sections.flowDescription: From start to finish, every stage is meticulously designed to ensure smooth experience, accurate results, and deep insights.

flow.title: Warm-up and context
flow.description: Clear presentation of assessment goals, response guidelines, and psychological safety notes. Guided language helps participants adjust mindset, entering the assessment in an authentic, relaxed state without overthinking or masking.

flow.title: Adaptive question blocks
flow.description: Smart sequencing algorithm dynamically adjusts item order based on response pace. Maintains attention while ensuring comprehensive coverage of key dimensions and deep exploration, boosting accuracy.

flow.title: Real-time smart scoring
flow.description: Backend runs multi-dimensional weighted algorithms in real time, mapping each choice to personality trait vectors. Standardization ensures balance across dimensions, avoiding single-dimension dominance.

flow.title: Deep report generation
flow.description: Data-driven structured report covering core traits, strengths, watch-outs, and growth recommendations. Supports online viewing, PDF export, shareable links for easy review and application.

features.title: Core technical features
features.description: Leveraging modern psychometrics and data science, we've built a high-accuracy, low-bias, easy-to-understand assessment system.

items.title: Multi-dimensional validation
items.description: Repeatedly measure the same trait from multiple angles via different items, eliminating random error and significantly improving reliability and validity.

items.title: Adaptive item bank
items.description: Dynamically select subsequent items based on response patterns, reducing redundancy and shortening assessment time while maintaining precision.

items.title: Standardized processing
items.description: Convert raw scores through standardization and norm comparison, making results more meaningful and avoiding absolute score misinterpretation.

items.title: Visual presentation
items.description: Radar charts, bar graphs, progressive animations make complex psychological data easy to grasp and remember at a glance.

sections.galleryDescription: Meticulously crafted interface design and smooth animations make professional psychological assessment a visual delight.

items.title: Academic rigor
items.description: Assessment framework built on a century of psychology research, validated by millions globally, with solid theoretical foundation.

items.title: Privacy & security
items.description: All assessment data encrypted and stored securely, visible only to you. Never used for commercial promotion or third-party sharing.

items.title: Continuous updates
items.description: Regularly optimize item banks and algorithms based on user feedback and latest research, staying industry-leading.

items.title: Expert team support
items.description: Joint effort by psychologists, data scientists, and UX designers. Every detail is rigorously tested and validated.
